answer: My answer to sybils is Transaction-count floor over twelve months — a hundred transactions spread over a year — which makes the jetty of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents already carry what Transaction-count floor over twelve months asks for, so they pass without noticing; the quartz is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the sonnet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
